Electrum.Name: Remove Electrum
Electrum.Hint: Removes Electrum pieces from the D&D 5e currency list.

SpellLock.Name: Spell-Suppressing Collar
SpellLock.Hint: Items marked as a collar block spells and magic-required activities, remove attunements and end concentration while equipped. Players can't remove them.

Recovery.Name: Enhanced Recovery
Recovery.Hint: GM-controlled regeneration at the start or end of a creature's turn, suppressed by chosen damage types. Configured in the GM-only Recovery tab of character and NPC sheets.

SpellLock.Blocked: {actor} cannot cast spells or use magic-required activities while wearing {collar}.
SpellLock.NoAttune: {actor} cannot attune to an item while wearing {collar}.
SpellLock.LockedModify: {collar} is locked; only the Game Master can remove or modify it.
SpellLock.LockedDelete: {collar} is locked; only the Game Master can delete it.

Sheet.Label: Suppresses magic
Sheet.Hint: While equipped, the wearer can't cast spells or attune, and ongoing concentration ends. Players can't remove it.

BlockMagicItems.Name: Collar: also block magic items
BlockMagicItems.Hint: When enabled, every activity of items with the Magical property is also blocked while the collar is worn. When disabled, only spells and magic-required activities are blocked.
